detail.title: CP-SL06K
detail.overview: Solar Panel Kit with built-in Battery
features: Backup time 12 Hours (Assumption based on 76.8Wh  Battery Capacity and 5.5 Watt continuous load)
Indications LED Battery charging: Green Blink
Indications LED Full charge: Green ON
Indications LED Battery discharge: Red ON

General.Charge current: Up to 1.5 A (Depends on Solar irradiation and Battery SOC)
General.Dimension: 70 mm x 130 mm x 35 mm (±10) mm
General.Voltage During Charging: 12V (+/-10%), Will be adjusted slightly based on Cable length
General.Voltage During Discharging: 12V (+/- 10%), Will be adjusted slightly based on Cable length
General.Load: 12 Watt Camera load (Load varies from 2.65 Watt to 10
General.Backup time: 12 Hours (Assumption based on 76.8Wh Battery Capacity and 5.5 Watt continuous load)  Battery backup may vary based on the change in Power consumption
General.LED: 1.Battery charging: Green Blink                                                                                                                           2.Full charge: Green ON                                                                                                                              3.Battery discharge: Red ON
General.Battery primary protection: Using a separate PCB inside the battery pack to protect from all kinds of faults and issues men t ioned below.                                                                                                                                                   1.Over current and Short circuit protection                                                                                             2.Over voltage protection                                                                                                                              3.Under voltage protection                                                                                                                             4.Over charge protection                                                                                                                                 5.Deep discharge protection                                                                                                                            6.Over temperature protection
